name: Lucy - Jinx (Fixed)
creator: magnaplayer
description:
# Lucy as Jinx

Bring the world of *Cyberpunk: Edgerunners* to the Rift with this Lucy replacement for Jinx.

This mod transforms Jinx into Lucy, featuring a custom model and animation adjustments designed to better match her appearance and style. Every effort has been made to make Lucy feel natural in-game while preserving Jinx's original gameplay and abilities.

Several animations have been adapted by hand to fit the model. While a few may look slightly different from the base champion, they help create a more immersive and unique experience.

Whether you're a fan of *Cyberpunk: Edgerunners* or simply looking for a fresh champion replacement, this mod lets you bring one of Night City's most iconic characters into League of Legends and wreak havoc across the Rift in style.
